description: One JSON object per LLM call in the triage cascade (generator or evaluator). Written as a run artifact (JSONL) and aggregated to data/llm-telemetry/YYYY-MM.json by the automation PR. This is the retro/blog dataset.

required_fields.ts: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of call completion
required_fields.pr: PR number under triage, or null for golden-set replay
required_fields.model: full model id, e.g. z-ai/glm-5.3-flash:free or glm-5.3-flash
required_fields.effort: reasoning effort requested: low | high | max | free-tier-default
required_fields.round: cascade round 1 | 2 (HITL escalation produces no further calls)

usage_fields.cost_estimate_usd: 0 for :free; Z.ai coding-plan calls amortized to 0 but flagged in provider note

outcome_fields.eval_verdict: evaluator output: pass | fail | null (generator rows carry the paired verdict)
outcome_fields.golden_case_id: matched golden fixture case, or null for novel
